'''Lusankya REVISED-HDADTJ''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lusankya]]
* '''Published:''' 14 June 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HD Lusankya DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A dueling HD deck. I made some changes to give this deck more battlegrounds and some space.

== Strategy ==

Changes: I added Bossk In Hounds tooth and Dengar in punishing1 to help combat space decks, and the naboo sites, LLL(v) and the holotable to give the deck some battlegrounds. I also put in 2 unsalvageables
to combat OOC&TT, and Corporal Derdram because i dont have another visage. I changed the ghhhk combo to an ANH one so that i could use it as a Dejarik, and put in Masterful Mone/endor occupation so i could get the table(and Ghhk & The Phantom Menace)

On your first turn, use Bad feeling have I to pull deep hatred and they will be no match for you, and use crush to get evader if it looks like they're playing a revolution deck.also, use LLL(v) to get theed palace generator if you have the 2 force
Duel using jade or vader against luke, vader against obi-wan, and maul against any other jedi.  TWBNMFY, the ebb of battle and focused attack all give you an advantage in duels, and you should win all of them with the high destiny and Deep hatred. Use siddius to place any jedi not already oop by epic duel oop, and beatdown on any other characters.

a good advantage of this deck is that between BFHI and Crush the rebellion, you can get almost every interrupt in the deck,  and you can use the  high destiny ones you pull as combat cards

I'd still apreciate any other comments or suggestions.
